description: This addendum defines applicable data-processing obligations for eligible business customers.

paragraphs.text: This addendum defines applicable data-processing obligations for eligible business customers.
The addendum defines controller and processor roles, permitted instructions, and the scope of processing.
The addendum sets contractual requirements for confidentiality and applicable technical and organizational security measures.
The addendum describes subprocessors, notification arrangements, responsibilities, and applicable objection mechanisms.
